'''Cave crawlers''' are [[Slayer]] monsters that require level 10 slayer to kill. They are, however, poisonous, making them slightly more dangerous than their [[combat level]] suggests. They appear in all floors, but are extremely rare on the Frozen floors, and drop the special [[Sunstriker boots]] and [[Marksman boots]].
